_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Test Package
summary: Specifies preparation instructions for the Test Package used to examine and evaluate an individual's or unit's achievement of specific learning objectives or performance standards.
use_relationship:
The Test Package is used to examine and evaluate an individual's or unit's achievement of specific learning objectives or performance standards.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the preparation instructions for the content and format of the Test Package.

This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the performance requirements described by 3.2.9 of MIL-PRF-29612B, and is applicable to the acquisition of training data products. Data product performance evaluation criteria are specified in 4.3.9 of MIL-PRF-29612B.

It is not intended that all the requirements contained herein should be applied to every program or program phase. Any individual data requirement contained in this DID is subject to deletion tailoring.

This DID supersedes DI-SESS-81525C.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and reviews, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The contractor format is acceptable. Standard digital data, when specified must be in compliance with the content and format requirements specified in the DoD Data Architecture (DDA) and the Defense Data Dictionary System (DDDS). The deliverable of the product required by this DID meets the intent and requirements of DODINST 5000.2.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The Test Package shall contain the following:

children.title: Front matter
children.content: The content of front matter shall be in accordance with Appendix A of MIL-PRF-29612B.

children.title: Test items
children.content: This data shall consist of the following:

children.title: Individual test items
Test item identifier
A cross-reference list of test item identifiers and related Learning Objective (LO) identifiers
Answers to individual test items with the supporting reference identifier
A description of test item criticality to
Safety
Overall measurement of trainee's ability to perform required tasks
Environmental considerations
A description of test item constraints (e.g., personnel, safety, environmental)
A description of test item support materials (e.g., publications, equipment, software, and hardware requirements)
Test item type (e.g., performance, prediction of performance)
Test(s)
children.content: This data shall consist of the following:

children.title: Cover sheet
Instructions for taking the test
Safety considerations
Test items
Student response recording capability
A list of all materials required for test item administration and completion
Computer managed instruction interface capability
Storage and maintenance instructions and container/jacket
Random test generation capability
Test type (e.g., performance, prediction of performance)
Test administration materials
children.content: This data shall consist of the following:

children.title: Testing plan
children.content: This data shall document the test strategy for individual courses and shall consist of the following:

children.title: Minimum passing grade for the course and rationale
Schedule of tests administered in the course and learning objectives measured by each test
A description of the types of tests
children.content: A description of the types of tests (e.g., adaptive test, aptitude test, achievement test, comparative test, criterion-referenced test, performance test, performance-based test, etc.) used to determine the trainee's grade, with rationale.

children.title: A description of the grading method
children.content: A description of the grading method (e.g., normative, criterion referenced, grading criteria, weighting criteria, etc.) for evaluating student performance on the test, with rationale.

children.title: A description of the method to be used to determine the trainee's final course grade
A description of the review, remediation, and retesting procedures
A description of the testing constraints which prevent testing of learning objectives as stated with work-around justification
A description of the method
children.content: A description of the method (e.g., rating scales, yes/no, SAT/UNSAT) used to assign grades to performance tests with supporting documentation for conversion to numerical grade.

children.title: Rationale for courses which have SAT/UNSAT grading criteria
Rationale for test item and test placement within the structure of the course
A description of the methodology for generation of random tests
A description of the testing procedures and security considerations for web-based testing
Test administration data
children.content: This data shall contain the materials necessary for the test administrator to conduct individual tests. It shall consist of:

children.title: Cover
Instructions to the individual conducting the tests
children.content: Instructions to the individual conducting the tests shall include pre-test duties to be completed in preparation for the test, pre-test instructions to the individuals taking the test, test monitoring guidance, and post-test instructions.

children.title: Test answer sheet to include data identifying location of response in supporting documentation
Answer key(s)/scoring templates
A description of test item criticality to
Safety
Overall measurement of trainee's ability to perform required tasks
Environmental considerations
A description of test item constraints (e.g., personnel, safety)
A description of test item support materials (e.g., publications, equipment)
Flow charts for computer-based tests
children.content: Flow charts for computer-based tests which depict the placement of test and test items within the course and branching for remediation.

children.title: Computer-based grade computation strategy
Test item selection criteria for computer generated test(s)
Program documentation for computer generated test(s)
Test supplements that contain information concerning special items required by the examinee during the test that will not be provided by the test administrator
Computer software for generation of multiple tests, by random selection of test items
Computer software for administration of tests (run-time version)
A description of testing procedures and security considerations for web-based testing
Test notices
children.content: This data shall contain information concerning test administration dates and the identity of study materials.

children.title: Test interoperability
children.content: This data shall contain information concerning the capability and structure of test and test items that support Sharable Content Objects (SCO), Course Structure Format (CSF), and Learning Management System (LMS).

children.title: Test item cross-reference chart
children.content: This data shall include a cross-reference chart showing the relationships among test item, lesson topic, learning objective, training task, and job task.

children.title: Standard digital data
children.content: Standard digital data shall be delivered for the Standard Data Elements (SDEs).
